title: The Voice on the Line
abstract: arXiv:2610.35272v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A transcriber listening through one microphone also hears everyone near it. We train causal voice isolators: masking transformers of 140M, 243M and 374M parameters, 20 ms of latency, enrolling the caller from the call itself. Short evaluation windows hide two failures that real calls expose: forgetting the caller when another voice talks alone for a while, and damaging a caller who is alone. Long calls with turns, memory beyond the attention window, real headset crosstalk and drifting caller levels address both, but each trades one against the other. WavLM-Large's own weights, made causal and trained with the model, move the trade: M with them (555M parameters) lowers the error on our development sets from 11.44% to 10.55%; a student trained from scratch to imitate WavLM does not, and w2v-BERT 2.0 and Whisper's encoder, pre-trained on far more audio, help less or not at all. translated_abstract: 通过一个麦克风收听的转录器也会听到麦克风附近的所有人。我们训练了因果语音隔离器：参数量分别为1.4亿、2.43亿和3.74亿的掩码transformer，延迟为20毫秒，直接从通话本身注册来电者的声音。短时间的评估窗口会掩盖真实通话中暴露出的两种失败：当另一个声音单独说话一段时间后遗忘来电者，以及损害正在单独说话的来电者的语音。带有话轮转换的长通话、超出注意力窗口的记忆、真实的耳机串音以及漂移的来电者音量水平能够同时应对这两个问题，但每一种方法都会以牺牲一方为代价换取另一方。将WavLM-Large自身的权重改造为因果形式并与模型联合训练，能够改变这种权衡：采用这些权重的M模型（5.55亿参数）将开发集上的错误率从11.44%降至10.55%；从零开始训练以模仿WavLM的学生模型则无法做到这一点，而在多得多的音频上预训练的w2v-BERT 2.0和Whisper编码器的帮助较小或毫无帮助。单独说话的来电者在录音开始时损失最大：（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文训练了20毫秒延迟、能从通话本身注册来电者的因果语音隔离器（掩码transformer），并发现将WavLM-Large权重因果化并与模型联合训练能显著提升效果，将开发集错误率从11.44%降至10.55%。
en_tdlr: The paper trains causal voice isolators (masking transformers with 20ms latency) that enroll the caller from the call itself, showing that causally-adapted WavLM-Large weights trained jointly with the model reduce error from 11.44% to 10.55%, outperforming imitation students and larger pre-trained encoders like w2v-BERT 2.0 and Whisper.
